name: Buying Your Luxury Home: What to Prepare Before You Start

step.name: Step 1: Financial Documentation: Gather all necessary paperwork for jumbo-l…
step.text: Financial Documentation: Gather all necessary paperwork for jumbo-loan pre-approval, including several years of tax returns, bank statements, investment account summaries, and proof of other assets. If paying cash, ensure your proof of funds is easily accessible and verifiable.

step.name: Step 2: Define Your Non-Negotiables: Sit down and really clarify what essen…
step.text: Define Your Non-Negotiables: Sit down and really clarify what essential features and location requirements are absolute must-haves. This goes beyond bedrooms and bathrooms – think about privacy needs, specific architectural styles, construction quality, views, and future development concerns. Knowing these helps narrow the search to truly suitable properties, including those exclusive off-market opportunities. This clarity also helps your agent target your search efficiently.

step.name: Step 3: Understand Ownership Costs: Beyond the purchase price, prepare to u…
step.text: Understand Ownership Costs: Beyond the purchase price, prepare to understand and budget for ongoing ownership costs. This includes property taxes, insurance, potential HOA or co-op fees, and maintenance for specialized systems. A clear picture of these recurring expenses will ensure the property remains a joy, not a burden. Don't forget to account for any unique amenities that might require specific upkeep.
